claims: Demolition consists of Ax (Bill Eadie) and Smash (Barry Darsow).
Demolition are officially WWE Hall of Famers.
Demolition held the WWF Tag Team Championship for a record 478 days.
Demolition were later managed by Mr. Fuji.
Demolition were inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 by Haku, Arn Anderson, and Warlord.
Demolition held the record for the longest tag team title reign for nearly three decades.
Demolition primarily consist of Axe and Smash.
Brian Adams (Crush) later joined Demolition in 1990.
Demolition had feuds with the Powers of Pain.
Demolition had feuds with the Brain Busters.
Demolition's entrance theme is "Here Comes the Ax, Here Comes the Smasher".
